For certain acquisitions that occurred in 2008, the Company is in the process of obtaining or finalizing
appraisals of tangible and intangible assets and it is continuing to evaluate the initial purchase price allocations, as
of the acquisition date, which will be adjusted as additional information relative to the fair values of the assets and
liabilities of the businesses becomes known. Accordingly, management has used their best estimate in the initial
purchase price allocation as of the date of these financial statements.
